title: Golden Fleece
summary: The Golden Fleece was an ancient artifact that was sought after by Jason and his Argonauts throughout his quest. The fleece remained in the Argo just off the shores of Sutos.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Golden Fleece was the fleece of a rare golden ram and the coveted prize of Jason and the Argonauts' quest. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Whilst diving down to the Argo to recover Jason's Hoplite Amulets, Zhalia Moon encountered the Golden Fleece among other items including the Apple of Paris and Hercules' Arrow. Placing a coin on the pedestal of the Golden Fleece unlocked the vault, allowing her to recover the chest of Dragon's teeth and the Amulets of the Hoplite Titans. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

The '''Golden Fleece''' was an ancient artifact that was sought after by [[Jason]] and his Argonauts throughout his quest. The fleece remained in the [[Argo]] just off the shores of [[Sutos]].

== History ==
The Golden Fleece was the fleece of a rare golden ram and the coveted prize of Jason and the Argonauts' quest. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}

Whilst diving down to the [[Argo]] to recover Jason's [[Hoplite]] [[Amulets]], [[Zhalia Moon]] encountered the [[Golden Fleece]] among other items including the [[Apple of Paris]] and [[Hercules' Arrow]]. Placing a coin on the pedestal of the Golden Fleece unlocked the vault, allowing her to recover the chest of [[Dragon's teeth]] and the Amulets of the Hoplite Titans. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}
